test_title: PYST 5: SSC CPO - English Comprehension (Held On 11 Dec, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: english
question: Select the most appropriate meaning of the underlined idiom in the following sentence. If you want to participate in the Olympics, you need to hit the ground running.
solution: The correct answer is **Option(1)** i.e. **Started working energetically**. **__Key Points__** __ • The idiom **'hit the ground running'** means to start a new activity with great **enthusiasm**, **speed**, and **immediate success** without any delay or hesitation. (बिना समय गँवाए ऊर्जा के साथ किसी कार्य को शुरू करना) • **Example:** The new marketing manager **hit the ground running** by launching three successful campaigns in his first month. • **'Started working energetically'** refers to beginning a task or responsibility with a lot of **vigor**, **power**, and **active effort**. (ऊर्जा के साथ काम शुरू किया) • **Example:** After the morning meeting, the developers **started working energetically** on the new software update. • Hence, the most appropriate meaning of the underlined idiom is to have **started working energetically**. Therefore, the correct answer is- **Started working energetically**. **Additional Information__** Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences: • **Took a break** (विराम लिया): To stop performing an activity for a short period, usually to rest or relax. • **Example:** The hikers **took a break** at the summit to enjoy the view and drink some water. • **Made a mistake** (गलती की): To perform an action that is incorrect, misguided, or produces an unintended result. • **Example:** I think I **made a mistake** by adding too much salt to the soup. • **Fell down** (नीचे गिर गया): To drop to the ground unexpectedly or lose one's balance. • **Example:** The toddler **fell down** while trying to run but quickly got back up. 61:Tc59, The correct answer is: **An unfair or unethical remark**.
